_note: Every unique sprite sheet the API must generate. One row per sheet on #FF00FF, equal cells, shared baseline. Each pose is listed once; frames.json reuses them. Model sheets lock the four character designs and are attached as references to that character's other sheets.
style: Polished hi-bit pixel art matching the reference garden: crisp pixel clusters, no blur, no anti-aliasing, warm sunrise light from the left. Stylised game sprite about 3 heads tall, dot eyes, simple rounded shapes, 2-3 tone flat shading, 1px darker outline, at most 10 colours, same pixel grid size as the scenery.
